study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Xiao et al., Biological Psychiatry: Global Open Science, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deviations From Normative Functioning Underlying Emotional Episodic Memory Revealed Cross-Scale Neurodiverse Alterations Linked to Affective Symptoms in Distinct Psychiatric Disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two datasets were used: the Healthy dataset from the Center for MRI Research, Peking University, and the Clinical dataset from the Center for Neuroimaging, Peking University Sixth Hospital.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The healthy dataset included 409 healthy control (HC) participants (HCtrain group) recruited from the Center for MRI Research, Peking University. The clinical dataset consisted of 324 individuals... 164 HC participants (HCtest group). These participants were recruited from the Center for Neuroimaging, Peking University Sixth Hospital."
